summary: Caterpillar Financial Services Corp filed an 8-K reporting entry into routine credit facilities, including a new $3.5 billion 364-day revolving credit facility and amendments/extensions of existing three-year and five-year facilities, dated August 27, 2026. These are ordinary financing agreements, not special-situation transactions. No equity securities, M&A, tender offers, or restructuring events are involved. The filing solely creates direct financial obligations under standard credit agreements with multiple banks and agents. No deal terms are applicable; this is a routine capital management matter.
